sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for call locking
sections.what: Brings in the response helper, the sign-in check, the parser, the limiter, the error type, the lock function and the lock input shape.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the route needing these pieces.

sections.name: limiter
sections.title: Lock a call handler
sections.what: Allows 20 locks per user per minute, checks the pick, locks the call and returns it with status 201.
sections.why: Likely reason: the limit protects against spam and keeps the lock records clean.
sections.watch_out: The limiter is in memory, so the limit resets on restart and may differ across server copies.

summary: Lets a signed-in fan lock one call in the Decision Lab, limited to 20 locks per user per minute.
purpose: Records a fan's pick so it can be graded later.
why: The comment says a call is locked with one pick and server time, so the outcome cannot be changed after the fact.
how: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Checks the per-user limit. 3) Checks the body. 4) Locks the call and returns it with status 201.
inputs: A POST with a JSON body holding the pick. The user comes from the session.
risks: The lock rules are in the lab service, so changes there change what counts as a valid lock.
debug: If locks fail, check the body shape in the lab types and the lock function in the lab service.
